hypothesis: H8: Mesh-aware AT2 energy comparison explains reproducible refinement bias across holdout states without calibration to Package 113
finding: Hypothesis H8 is SUPPORTED PROSPECTIVELY: Independent out-of-sample holdout evaluations on Package 119 (Increment 85, |r_E| = 0.209% <= 0.250%) and Package 123 (Increment 86, |r_E| = 0.235% <= 0.250%) confirm that the mesh-dependent regularized AT2 fracture energy scaling explains a reproducible +1.92% to +2.16% energy offset upon C3 -> C4 refinement, without calibration to Package 113. However, this finding is strictly bounded to the pre-peak stationary regime (d_max <= 0.65), as demonstrated by the failure of Package 120 (Increment 88, r_E = -0.466%) under active localized softening. In accordance with thesis governance, this prospective physical criterion provides evidentiary justification for future supervisory threshold revision but does NOT retroactively alter the failed Level 3 gate for Package 113 (+2.0080315% > 2.0000000%). Binding gate STAGE_C1_2_STEP2_ENERGY_GATE_FAILED remains strictly retained.

PACKAGE_94.reason: Historical transfer run prior to frozen unified 12-DOF active set UEL harmonization.

domain_of_applicability.valid_regime: Pre-peak stationary equilibrium where d_max <= 0.65 and alternating minimization converges within 15 cycles (Delta d_max <= 1e-3).
domain_of_applicability.invalid_regime: Active post-peak localized crack propagation where d_max >= 0.70 and continuous within-step relaxation causes stationary divergence.
domain_of_applicability.holdout_accuracy_in_valid_regime: Residual |r_E| <= 0.235% across all validated stationary holdouts (Increments 85 and 86).
domain_of_applicability.error_trend: Negative residual deepens systematically as damage localization approaches softening boundary (-0.209% at Inc 85 -> -0.235% at Inc 86 -> -0.466% at Inc 88).

hpc_execution_justification.rationale: Investigation is a mathematically closed analytical and holdout synthesis of existing authentic solver deliverables. No ungrounded cluster jobs are permitted.
